1.

Not yet do we see all things Subjected to our Lord, Not yet is earth’s glory Brought to His feet. But He who once was made lower Than all the angels, Risen from the power of death, Our Jesus now we see.

2.

We await that morning When faith shall be exchanged For sight and clear vision At the close of the wilderness journey; Yet even now in that blessedness May our souls dwell, And amid the changes of time Enjoy heavenly rest.

3.

Soon shall we, O Jesus, Behold Thee as Thou art, Help us to more patiently, More faithfully witness here Of Thee, who in a sinful world Wast God’s faithful witness, And thus for them follow Thee A path here hast prepared.

4.

We praise Thee, our Lord, As Thy Spirit teaches us, That Thou hast opened the way For us to the Father’s world. Thy desire is to have us In spirit with Thee there, That in us may be perfected Thy joy already here.
